issues.item: Triggers: Sexual Objectification: Being looked at sexually
issues.explanation: The profile is for a male patient with police trauma, but two trigger items and the body-shame appraisal are specifically sexual-trauma themed. That is hard to reconcile with the indexed trauma type unless there is an additional sexual trauma history, which is not supported elsewhere in the profile.

issues.item: Triggers: Sexual Trauma Cues: Comments on sexual violence
issues.explanation: Within the trigger/appraisal cluster, the content centers on sexual victimization, while the rest of the profile does not describe corresponding sexual-trauma memory content or threat meaning. This makes the selected items clinically incoherent as a single trauma-linked PTSD profile.

issues.item: Negative Appraisals: Body Shame: I feel ashamed of what happened to my body
issues.explanation: Door/window checking suggests a home-intrusion or generalized safety threat, but the trigger and appraisal content centers on sexualized trauma cues. That threat item is not well linked to the rest of the selected profile and pulls the formulation in a different direction.

issues.item: Triggers: Sexual Trauma Cues: Comments on sexual violence
issues.explanation: For a police trauma in a 47-year-old male bus driver, sexual-trauma-specific trigger content is hard to reconcile unless the index event involved sexual assault or exposure to sexual violence in a highly personal way; nothing else in the profile supports that specificity.

issues.item: Negative Appraisals: Body Shame: I feel ashamed of what happened to my body
issues.explanation: Body-focused shame is more characteristic of sexual assault or severe bodily violation. In this profile it does not cohere with the police trauma framing, and it is reinforced only by the sexual-trauma-specific trigger, creating an implausible subtheme not supported by the rest of the nodes.
